_meta.description: D6 fixtures for langgraph-fastapi / gen-ui-open + gen-ui-open-advanced
_meta._note: The open-gen-ui + open-gen-ui-advanced pill fixtures (3D axis, neural net, quicksort, Fourier, calculator, ping-host, inline evaluator) are the comprehensive set and live in gen-ui-tool-based.json for this integration. Keeping them here too duplicated the leg-1 tool-call fixtures with a DIFFERENT toolCallId for the same userMessage; because aimock pools every d6/<slug> file into one match set and 'first substring match wins', the two leg-1 fixtures competed and the follow-up terminal (toolCallId-anchored) never matched -> done-signal-missing loop. This file is intentionally empty of open pills so gen-ui-tool-based.json is the single source.
